evidence.quote: David MacNeil Kanthini Crawford Kanthini Crawford Business Development David has devoted his career to wealth management and has many years of experience at some of the most pre-eminent names in the industry.  He has always been very interested in entrepreneurship and developed relationships and friendships with people who started their own businesses.  A seed was planted and before long the genesis of Castlebay was planted.  At its heart was a desire to be in partnership and invest alongside investors for the long term.  A simple but effective alignment of best interests, which is all too lacking in our industry.  With the YFS Chawton Global Equity Income Fund now managed by Castlebay advised by Chawton Global Investors, David is driving business development including marketing and investor relations.
